with the comment "authoring them from an aggregate id alone would mean minting a graph or plan digest locally". Its signature is unchanged for rail 3, and both operands are deliberately discarded. So no fixture reachable through `payloadFor` can ever make these arms green — that is why five of six failures die inside the helpers `chainOf` (:34) and `approvalFor` (:53) before reaching an assertion.
THE ONLY AUTHORING PATH IS `planningPayloadFor(kind, offer, version, planningGoalRef)` at live-planning-authorities.ts:368, and it is keyed on the OFFER RECORD's object identity through a module-private WeakMap: "Material is looked up by the offer RECORD, so an unbound or caller-minted offer authors nothing". The finalize carries `graphContentHash` but NEVER `graphContentBytesBase64` (:311 — that key is in the daemon's FORBIDDEN_BODY_KEYS and a finalize holding it is refused whole).
